scope: Read-only checkpoint matrix inspection; no model construction, token input, attention computation, forward pass, or performance evaluation.

calculation.arithmetic: CPU float64 from original stored tensors; no tensors written back
calculation.layout: Each head occupies192 consecutive QKV rows:64 Q,64 K,64 V; O is512x64 matching output columns.
calculation.ln_value_constant: O_h @ (V_h @ input_layernorm.bias + value_projection_bias_h); shared attention output bias excluded
calculation.cosine: Frobenius inner product of flattened OV matrices divided by their Frobenius norms
calculation.trace: Signed sum of diagonal entries; not a claim about copied tokens or induction
calculation.rank: 1 is largest signed value; traces ranked signed, not by absolute magnitude

excluded_effects: Input-dependent LayerNorm inverse standard deviation and its Jacobian; only fixed gain and centering are included.
Q/K interactions, Q/K biases in routing, rotary positions, causal masking, and softmax attention probabilities; Q/K norms alone do not reconstruct routing.
Actual residual distributions, cross-token attention patterns, subsequent MLPs/layers/final norm/output logits, and interactions from recurrent feedback.
Dataset loss and causal circuit roles; matrix alignment does not imply aligned realized head outputs.
